description: Source code for quantized convolution unpacking functions in PyTorch, including classes and registration for different backends and convolution types.

classes.name: QConvUnpackWeightsInt8
classes.description: Class for unpacking 8-bit quantized convolution weights for 2D convolution, supporting different backends.

classes.name: QConv1dUnpackWeightsInt8
classes.description: Class for unpacking 8-bit quantized convolution weights for 1D convolution.

classes.name: QConvStride
classes.description: Class providing stride information for packed convolution weights.

classes.name: QConvPadding
classes.description: Class providing padding information for packed convolution weights.

classes.name: QConvOutputPadding
classes.description: Class providing output padding information for packed convolution weights.

classes.name: QConvDilation
classes.description: Class providing dilation information for packed convolution weights.

classes.name: QConvGroups
classes.description: Class providing group count for packed convolution weights.

classes.name: QConvTranspose
classes.description: Class providing transpose information for packed convolution weights.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes unpacking of convolution weights for 2D or 1D, depending on class, based on backend.

methods.name: unpack_quantized_prepacked_sizes_conv2d
methods.description: Extracts sizes and parameters from a quantized convolution packed parameters object.
